title: Layer 3 round 6 major security: config_inputs_hash — the 4th ActiveComposition string field — is uncleaned at read_state and reaches the machine form raw; #799 cleaned three of the four sibling fields and missed it

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: PHASE-4 ROUTING (under the #806 format-carry). Routing question — what artifact, had it been correct, would have prevented config_inputs_hash reaching the machine form raw? Not the implementation: the DESIGN.md Status requirement never specifies terminal-output safety at all, so there was no spec to build the sanitization against and no boundary saying which fields it covers. ROUTE TO: Phase 1a/1b — the terminal-safety spec amendment (drafted next on this trail). config_inputs_hash is one member of the terminal-safety class; it is covered for free by the amendment's systematic sink (recursive machine-form sanitization) and its mechanism (the Default_Ignorable UCD property), not by another hand-picked field patch. NOT fix-closed in Layer 3; stays open, routed, until the amendment lands and the rebuild verifies.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Resolved by the Layer-3 rebuild (#813, commits 24e76e2e + f06d0797): the Default_Ignorable_Code_Point property predicate + whole-of-output machine-form sanitizer (values and keys) close this systematically. Verified layer-3-closeable by the closing verify round (empirical strip/preserve probe + mutation tests). Closing with no separate changelog entry — the #813 rebuild entry carries the substance.
